svg.title: HomeFinder
svg.desc: Full-stack rental and valuation platform. Multi-tier real estate platform on React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with JWT authentication. Flask microservice running an XGBoost regression model predicts dynamic rent at 80% accuracy. Responsive Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui workflows over RESTful pipelines tuned for low latency.
svg.text: Multi-tier real estate platform on React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with JWT
Flask microservice running an XGBoost regression model predicts dynamic rent at 80% accuracy.
